title: fix(xclaim): send TIME only when timeMS is set and keep zero values

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+"@upstash/redis": patch
+---
+
+Fix commands dropping valid zero or empty arguments: `expire` with 0 seconds, `geoadd` with a latitude of 0, `xtrim` with `limit: 0`, `xautoclaim` with `count: 0`, and `scan`, `hscan`, `sscan` and `zscan` with an empty `match`

@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+"@upstash/redis": patch
+---
+
+Fix XCLAIM building TIME from idleMS and dropping zero-valued idleMS, timeMS and retryCount
